correctness.rationale: PASS — Projection brightness is Σw_i|U_i| and its minimum is attained precisely at poles indexed by minimal w_i. Spherical pole charts x give Jacobian 1/(s_{d−1}√(1−|x|²)); the rare event forces |x|=O(t) because all limiting weights stay positive. Rescale x=ty: the fixed-shape leading tangent region is a weighted crosspolytope, with two antipodal charts, giving the displayed coefficient. Radial chart expansion r_max=1+(mt/2)Σz_j²/w_j²+O(t²), E_Dirichlet z_j²=2/[p(p+1)] with p=d−1, yields the relative +mt/d Σw_j^-2 correction. In the moving case threshold yields λ_i+Σw_j^0|y_j|<1; pointwise a.e. chart densities converge in L1 on common compact support, implying total variation of the marked pole/coordinate mixture, not just weak convergence. Signs are independent by orthant invariance and normalized absolute weighted coordinates plus slack have constant density p! on a simplex. For d4 weights (1,1+αt,c,c), s3=2π² gives 4/(3π²c²)[1+(1−α)_+³]. The script uses local importance Monte Carlo as numerical diagnostics only; no uniform remainder is asserted for degenerating weights.
